objective: Migrate and improve the existing Cabinet des Hérons public informational website while retaining source content and existing operational integrations.

product.audience: Families and professionals seeking public information about the practice
product.required_stack_candidate: Astro + TypeScript (implemented and CI-validated; Vite is managed internally by Astro)
product.selected_stack: Astro 7.3.5 static output, file-based routes, CSS interface and TypeScript strictest tsconfig

change_requests.requirement: Every successfully validated work-loop checkpoint is merged into main at the end.
change_requests.implementation: Use a GitHub pull request for each successful validated checkpoint, then verify the merged main ref. Never force-push. Main promotion does not itself authorize a final public-launch signoff.

change_requests.requirement: Use the user-provided CPAM and MDPH PDF viewer URLs and correct Street View embed.
change_requests.implementation: Both Drive links are implemented in src/pages/ressources-utiles.astro; the exact Street View src is implemented in src/pages/acces.astro with responsive CSS. PDF contents/downloads and Street View browser runtime remain unverified.

change_requests.requirement: Make the main branch compatible with Vercel so the owner can inspect the site using a URL.
change_requests.implementation: Production static build fingerprint matched commit 7153f320dfd0533b2dfd04bc06d06319a94ca56b on main. The public routes and local image URLs were independently exercised on desktop/mobile sizes; full accessibility and content approval remain open.

change_requests.requirement: Migrate essential images and branding from the source Google Sites website into local static assets to eliminate dependency on the fragile Google Sites image gateway.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 005 migrated the source-site logo, three selected interior photographs and three practitioner portraits into public/images/ as optimized WebP files. On 2026-10-14, all seven Production asset URLs returned HTTP 200 with image/webp and visual browser checks found no broken images at the tested desktop and mobile sizes.

change_requests.requirement: Improve crawl discovery and prevent duplicate alias routes from competing in search engines.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 007 adds a static sitemap.xml and robots.txt, canonical and Open Graph URL metadata, and noindex on duplicate aliases and the custom 404. Build checks validate the metadata and exact sitemap membership.

change_requests.requirement: Strengthen accessibility regression tests and improve contrast/navigation semantics.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 008 darkens --teal-deep to #3c7173 and checks 4.5:1 text contrast against key light surfaces. Static build validation checks H1/main count, image alt attributes, iframe titles, anchor names, noopener for target=_blank, heading progression, and group-page parent-navigation semantics.

change_requests.requirement: Protect the exact existing public operational destinations from accidental URL drift in future changes.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 009 extends scripts/verify-build.mjs with strict generated-HTML checks for the existing Google Form responder/embed URLs, supplied CPAM/MDPH viewer URLs, original Maps and full user-provided Street View iframe URLs, Maps directions, Tamis, public phone and email. No form submission or response access occurs. PR Actions remain the required validation gate.

change_requests.requirement: Improve the public website's visual design, information hierarchy, responsiveness and interaction polish without altering clinical/business content or existing integrations.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 010 adds a responsive editorial CSS refinement to the shared design system: home hero, brand/navigation, contact strip, section rhythm, cards, staff portraits, page intros, resource/FAQ/table panels and footer. Lightweight transitions honor prefers-reduced-motion; no new JavaScript, dependencies, external assets, or data storage are introduced. Full runtime visual acceptance remains pending.

change_requests.requirement: Improve the visual quality and responsive presentation of inner informational pages without changing source-approved healthcare/business content or external integrations.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 011 adds CSS-only refinement for PageIntro, editorial prose, pricing tables, group schedule cards, service-domain cards, practitioner-profile layouts, gallery panels, resource cards, FAQ details, map/embed headings and small-print rhythm. Practitioner profiles collapse into compact portrait/name headers on narrow mobile. Content values and external destinations unchanged; CI and later owner visual acceptance remain separate gates.

change_requests.requirement: Refine visual consistency and information scent by replacing mismatched Unicode glyphs with coherent decorative iconography, without adding remote dependencies or changing site content.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 012 replaces homepage service/info card glyphs and contact-strip symbols plus Accès-page facility glyphs with purpose-drawn inline SVG line icons. CSS enforces shared stroke geometry and responsive sizing. The contact strip now uses a phone handset for the public phone link rather than a generic outbound arrow. Icons remain decorative under aria-hidden wrappers; words, URLs and business content remain unchanged.

change_requests.requirement: Improve mobile navigation feedback and interaction-state clarity without changing page content, clinic information, or existing destinations.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 013 adds CSS-only open/closed feedback for the native mobile menu, a restrained menu-reveal and icon transition, pressed-state feedback for buttons, and reduced-motion handling. It corrects the mobile waiting-list CTA hover/focus treatment so white text remains on a dark teal surface instead of inheriting the generic pale-link hover background. Static verification guards these states; production visual acceptance remains gated by the owner's manual deployment.

change_requests.requirement: Make practitioner pricing tables easier to navigate with keyboard and assistive technologies, especially when horizontal scrolling is needed on narrow screens, without changing published rates or clinic wording.
change_requests.implementation: Loop 014 gives each practitioner's existing pricing-table scroll wrapper role=region, tabindex=0, and a descriptive accessible name; each table also has a visually-hidden caption. CSS adds a clearly visible keyboard-focus outline and compact scrollbar styling. The build verifier checks all three tables and their accessibility attributes.

validation_evidence.browser_runtime_qa: PARTIAL_2026-10-14: all 13 routes HTTP 200, custom invalid route HTTP 404, internal links passed, no horizontal overflow at 1365/390/320px, all rendered images loaded, seven WebP asset paths 200, existing Google Form and viewer/map URLs 200; no form submitted. Full visual, assistive-tech and PDF-content QA remains open.
validation_evidence.accessibility_contrast: Muted text token updated from #657b7e to #566b6f; static CI verifier now enforces >=4.5:1 against --paper and white backgrounds.
validation_evidence.accessibility: PR #9: automated semantic/contrast checks and parent-section navigation fix; manual screen-reader and complete WCAG audit remain outstanding.
validation_evidence.loop_009: Exact operational destination guards added to the static build verifier on aeos/loop-009-exact-integration-guards; see Loop 009 pull-request Actions for CI outcome. Production remains unverified until the owner deploys.
validation_evidence.loop_010: Responsive CSS design refinement committed on aeos/loop-010-visual-design-polish. CI and static verifier on PR #11 are required. No production deploy or post-change browser acceptance has been performed.
validation_evidence.loop_011: Inner-page visual refinement committed on aeos/loop-011-inner-page-design. PR #12 build and static verification required before merge. Runtime visual review remains pending; no deployment has been initiated.
validation_evidence.loop_012: Consistent inline SVG line-icon treatment committed on aeos/loop-012-consistent-iconography. PR #13 GitHub Actions build/static verification is the merge gate; post-deploy visual acceptance remains pending. No deployment initiated.
validation_evidence.loop_013: Responsive mobile navigation CSS and regression assertions are implemented on aeos/loop-013-mobile-interaction-polish. The pull-request GitHub Actions build/static verifier must pass before merge. No content or URLs changed, no dependency or JavaScript added, and no Vercel deployment initiated. Production visual acceptance remains pending.
validation_evidence.loop_014: Pricing table wrappers on the Prestations page now have named keyboard-focusable regions and hidden table captions, with responsive scrollbar/focus styling. Static build verifier now checks all three pricing tables. GitHub Actions on the loop PR remains the merge gate; no prices or service labels are changed, and no Vercel deployment initiated.
